items.title: George Guesnon Interview
items.q: No finer drummer in the city than him at no time. A fine fellow and a fine musician at all times. Jovial, laughing all the time, and one of the finest timekeepers you ever sat next to.

ctx.x: Okay, this just about finishes up. We can ask one more question about...
You asked something about Ernest Trepani, yeah?
